authority: Pax proposed daily personalized IP/artist/collaborator discovery and in-app/email delivery. User selected shared foundations while awaiting Pax’s final design.
scope: Backend persistence, shared contracts, Web/Mobile transport parity and internal daily planning only. No presentation, automatic AI calls or delivery enabled.

contract.identity: Authenticated user only; deployment-owned NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_REGION must be global or cn. Client input cannot select another account/site or an email recipient.
contract.preferences: Explicit intents (support nearby IPs, find collaborators, discover new IPs), interests, user-entered area, locale, IANA timezone, separate in-app/email choices. No inferred GPS or silent channel opt-in.
contract.update: mutationId + expectedRevision + preferences; null clears preferences and revokes channel choices. Unknown fields are rejected.
contract.recovery: Retry the unchanged command after a lost response. A stale revision returns conflict and must be reloaded/reviewed. Account-scoped client aborts and response identity/site validation prevent stale results from being applied; Mobile also checks auth generation.
contract.activation: Every response reports deliveryState=awaiting_design. Saving channel choices does not activate a subscription or dispatch work. Final UI must present the approved notice before collecting consent.

planning.entry: DiscoveryPreferencesService.reserveDay is internal and has no HTTP route, cron or worker invocation.
planning.deduplication: One reservation per account/site/local date, with a conservative minimum 24-hour interval across timezone changes. This is a planning guard, not an agreed delivery time; confirm timezone/DST cadence in final design.
planning.concurrency: Account/site advisory transaction lock coordinates preference edits and reservations; database primary key also enforces daily uniqueness.
planning.revocation: Any preference change cancels outstanding reservations. Reusing an old revision is rejected. Reservations are never marked generated or delivered.
planning.future_delivery: Must recheck current preference revision, channel consent, verified account email and current content access before dispatch. Add durable per-channel delivery/outbox receipts and uncertain-send recovery before enabling external messages.

migration: 20261006170000_discovery_preferences adds preference and planning tables only; no production migration was executed during this work.
pending_pax_isaac: Final questionnaire, placement and Web/Mobile presentation; IP Plaza redesign remains Pax-owned.
Recommendation ranking/value threshold, own-IP selection and eligible artist/distributor sources; reuse access-filtered discovery rather than private data in emails.
Delivery time, timezone/DST policy, no-result behavior, email templates, verified-recipient integration, consent notice and unsubscribe experience.
Regional rollout and AI budget/quotas; final in-app message routing and daily worker activation.
